description: Check an MCP server for tool poisoning before connecting: hidden instructions, sensitive-file access, exfiltration parameters, cross-tool shadowing, rug pulls. For skills or AGENTS.md use audit_agent_skill. Give url (tools are listed read-only, never called) or the pasted tools, not both. Returns level, findings (type, severity, location, snippet) and per-tool fingerprints to send back as pinned. Costs US$0.01 in USDC on Base (x402); servers that cannot be listed are not charged.

instructions.description: Only with tools: the server's instructions from its initialize result

pinned.description: Optional map of tool name to the fingerprint returned by a previous audit; any change is reported as tool-changed (high)

tools.description: Instead of url: the tools array of a tools/list result, pasted as is

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a public MCP server. Omit when pasting tools

name: audit_mcp_server
title: Audit an MCP server for tool poisoning
